flags.sentence: While the STM roadmap (measure 3.2.1) plans a national cancer quality registry alongside THL's Cancer Registry with the registry decree updated by 2026–2028 and 90% data coverage including stage by 2029–2031, the team recommends publishing per-county recording coverage for stage, drug treatment, and MDT coding and reading county gaps in these fields as data-quality signals first.
flags.problem: The cited claims state that the 2029–2031 timeframe in STM roadmap measure 3.2.1 applies to publishing annual reports for at least five cancers, whereas the 90% data coverage target in q:4a856bd695 is stated without a 2029–2031 deadline.
